definitions.forced_set: locals forced by degree-one frontier identities, including iterative safe forcing
definitions.residual_frontier: delta frontier not covered by forced locals
definitions.dominance: discard local neighborhood subset of another remaining neighborhood at equal cover cost
definitions.beta: fraction of original delta frontier covered by forced locals
definitions.component_sum: set-cover objective decomposes additively across disconnected residual components

interpretation_boundary: Forced choices are necessary for complete coverage under this representation. Dominance and component decomposition are safe for equal-cost set cover. Component lower bounds count one local for each nonempty disconnected component; component upper bounds retain all reduced candidates. No semantic necessity, runtime, sufficiency, or universal interface claim is made.
